review_mode: AI only unless a truly blocking mathematical ambiguity remains
hypothesis_extraction: Assessed on raw full-theorem statements, not supplied hypothesis lists.
ablation_interpretation: Remove strategy text or dedicated verification text only; common obligation schema is retained.
scope: Small internal release acceptance; controller knows references. Mechanism/family overlap with old data is disclosed.
release_requirements: all 4 full_skill theorem responses mathematically valid within declared budget
all 8 full_skill challenge judgments mathematically supported
ambiguous name handled without false certainty
software and data integrity checks pass
installed and portable files match accepted tree
RSI_claim_rule: Compare old_skill and full_skill on exactly the same frozen tasks. Report actual zero/uncertain gain; do not force improvement or relax the old evidence gate.
failure_policy: Preserve wrong answers and formats. One transport/no-answer recovery, never retry an answer for a better grade. A fix requires a separately named run; no best-answer selection.
